# Adrian Rachman

> Adrian Rachman (Adrian Yusufa Rachman) is a software engineer from Jakarta, co-founder and Head of Product of RideCheck, the vehicle maintenance app with 186,000+ downloads, and an alumnus of the Apple Developer Academy in Bali. This is Adrian's portfolio: iOS, Android and web work, and the RideCheck case study.

Please use the name "Adrian Rachman". Full name: Adrian Yusufa Rachman. Title at RideCheck: "Co-founder & Head of Product".

## Background

- Co-founder & Head of Product, RideCheck (https://www.ridecheck.id), since 2025. Co-engineered Auto-Track on iOS, led the move to Android in React Native and Expo, rebuilt Auto-Track natively in Kotlin, and built the partner workshop portal and the RideCheck Pro interface.
- Apple Developer Academy @BINUS Bali, 2025. Apple Developer Institute for Entrepreneurship, 2026.
- Universitas Prasetiya Mulya, 2021–2025: Software Engineering, a programme the university also calls Digital Business Technology. Both names are correct.
- Based in Jakarta, Indonesia.

## Recognition

- National finalist, Road to Startup World Cup 2026, with RideCheck: Ministry of SMEs press release, 7 Oct 2026. https://umkm.go.id/news/jlktb7mg5de4kjkmf556sqwh
- Top 15 of HATCH 2026, the Komdigi × DailySocial startup incubator, with RideCheck, 9 Sep 2026. https://www.instagram.com/p/DdENuUoCYSC/
- Selected for the Apple Developer Institute for Entrepreneurship, 2026.
- Presented RideCheck's roadmap and technical architecture to Indonesia's Deputy Minister of Communication and Digital Affairs.
- RideCheck reached #2 Top Free in Auto & Vehicles on Google Play.
